Morning, Thiago. Good weekend?
Busy. Saturday disappeared into errands, and then I did nothing.
That counts as downtime. What do you enjoy doing when you actually stop?
I enjoy watching the race, and I like cooking when there is time.
Do you work out as well, or is that only in January?
Twice a week. I do not mind getting up at six, but I cannot stand running in the heat.
Then come with us on Saturday. We are taking up running again, at seven.
Seven on a day off. That is early, but I do not mind trying once.
Good. It beats binge-watching another series until two in the morning.
My screen time on Sunday was higher than on Monday. I am not proud of that.
Nobody is. See you at seven, and we can unwind at breakfast afterwards.
I unwind by cooking, with the phone in another room.
I want to take up cycling before the summer.

Welcome to the wellbeing minute. This week we asked two hundred employees what they enjoy doing on their day off, and then what they really did. Almost everybody said reading or exercising. In practice, more than half spent the morning doing errands and the afternoon on a screen. Our advice is simple. Do not try to change everything. Choose one activity you like doing, put it in the calendar like a meeting, and protect that hour. People who do this say they unwind faster and they do not mind the busy weeks as much.

Hi Thiago, it is Rachel. I am calling about Saturday. A few of us are taking up running again before the summer, and we go at seven in the morning, which is early, I know. I do not mind waiting ten minutes if you are late. After that we usually have breakfast somewhere and the rest of the day is free. If you hate running, come for the breakfast. Let me know tonight, because I have to book the table.

First, Thiago wakes up early on his day off and works out before the heat. Then he does the errands he could not do during the week. After that, he unwinds with lunch and no screen at all. Next, he watches the race with friends in the afternoon. Finally, he plans the week ahead and goes to bed early.
